1. (Currently amended) A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor, wherein the functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor is a compound of formula I as defined in claim 6, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

2. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof as defined in claim 6, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII) selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

3. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof as defined in claim 6, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII) selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

4. (Currently amended) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 3, wherein components (I) and (II) are suitable for sequential, separate and/or simultaneous use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by microvascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

5. (Original) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 4, wherein the condition is hypertension, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and/or glomerulosclerosis.

6. (Original) A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the component that is BH4 or a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof is a compound of formula I, O R HN R2 N R3 R -N N N R4 H R5 R wherein R1 and R2 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; R3 represents aryl or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or more substituents selected from aryl, OR7 and oxo; R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)R8; R8 represents C1-4 alkyl, aryl, C1-4 alkoxy and C1-4 alkylamino; R4 and R5 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; and R6 represents H or C(O)-C1-3 alkyl.

7. (Original) A combination product as claimed in Claim 6, wherein R1 and R2 either both represent H or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached.

8. (Original) A combination product as claimed in Claim 6 or Claim 7, wherein R3 represents phenyl (optionally substituted by one to three substituents selected from halo, C1-3 alkyl and C1-3 alkoxy) or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or two substituents selected from OR7 and oxo.

9. (Original) A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 6 to 8, wherein R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)-C1-3 alkyl.

10. (Original) A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 6 to 9, wherein R4 and R5 both represent H.

11. (Original) A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 6 to 10, wherein R6 represents H.

12. (Original) A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 6 to 11, wherein R3 represents -CH3, -CH2OH, -C(O)C(O)CH3, -C(O)CH(OH)CH3, -CH(OH)CH(OH)CH3, -CH(OC(O)CH3)CH(OC(O)CH3)CH3 or unsubstituted phenyl.

13. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 1 to 12, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII) is a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist.

14. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 13, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII) is a compound selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof.

15. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 14, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII) is a compound selected from the group consisting of eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan or candesartan cilexetil, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt thereof.

16. (Currently amended) A method of making a kit of parts as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, which method comprises bringing a component (I), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, into association with a component (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, thus rendering the two components suitable for administration in conjunction with each other.

17. (Currently amended) A kit of parts comprising: (1) one of components (I) and (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15; together with (2) instructions to use that component in conjunction with the other of the two components.

18. (Original) A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 1 to 15 or a kit of parts as defined in Claim 17 for use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by vascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

19. (Original) A combination product as claimed in Claim 18, wherein the condition is hypertension, left ventricular dysfunction, heart failure, myocardial infarction, angina pectoris, coronary artery disease, peripheral artery disease, atherosclerosis, Reynaud's disease, migraine, cerebral apoplexy, retinopathy, neuropathy, nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, glomerulosclerosis, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic neuropathy, diabetic nephropathy, diabetic glomerulonephritis and/or diabetic glomerulosclerosis.

20. (Cancelled)

21. (Cancelled)

22. (Original) The use of a combination product as defined in any one of Claims 1 to 15 or a kit of parts as defined in Claim 17 for the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment or prophylaxis of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by vascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

23. (Original) The use of BH4, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof as defined in claim 6, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, together with an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII) selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof for the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment or prophylaxis of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by vascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

24. (Original) The use as claimed in Claim 22 or Claim 23, wherein the condition is hypertension, left ventricular dysfunction, heart failure, myocardial infarction, angina pectoris, coronary artery disease, peripheral artery disease, atherosclerosis, Reynaud's disease, migraine, cerebral apoplexy, retinopathy, neuropathy, nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, glomerulosclerosis, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic neuropathy, diabetic nephropathy, diabetic glomerulonephritis and/or diabetic glomerulosclerosis.
